name: baanrodmai
description: บ้านรอดไหม? (Baan Rod Mai?) — a Thai home-preparedness web app for any disaster: what-to-do guides for nine hazards, a home-kit checker and an emergency bag, a family plan card and an emergency info card, a safe message, calculators (the fridge in a power cut, PM2.5 dust and heat today, which mask, water days, tank chlorine), links to Thai agencies, and a 60-second hazard-hunt game, for Cloudflare Pages

scripts.deploy: node tools/build.mjs && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy public --project-name=baanrodmai
